dct_description_sm: From Rand, McNally & Company's New Commercial Atlas of America, c1912, p. 200-201.
Includes inset of "Business portion of Indianapolis on enlarged scale" (Scale 1:15,840).
On verso: partial index for Indiana and Indiana electric lines.
Shows city boundaries, selected buildings, parks, cemeteries etc.
